Salvador: Festival Virada Salvador, 5 days from December 30 to January 3 at the Boca do Rio arena; last year free, this year's entry rules not out yet

4 cities to ring in 2027 beyond Copacabana, 3 of them free 🎆
🎶 Recife, Praia do Pina: free, Dec 26, 27 and 31
🌊 Fortaleza, Praia de Iracema: free, Dec 30–31, 26 acts on 3 stages
🏙️ São Paulo, Avenida Paulista: free party on Dec 31
🥁 Salvador, Festival Virada: 5 days, Dec 30–Jan 3 (last year free; 2027 entry rules not out yet)
🛏️ Dec 31 is peak season: book your bed early
